text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option a 18.0 to 18.8 s. Ground-level flood street. The white car moves slowly right while the brown water rises from the hubs to above the wheel arches by 18.8. Houses, tree and street sign hold behind. A dark shape at the right edge withdraws by 18.4. Caption sits directly beneath the car on the curb line; car stays above it. Car is small, about a quarter of frame width.
